newsitem.title: UK: IBCA ups NationsBank units l-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA ups NationsBank units l-term ratings.

text.p: IBCA said on Tuesday it upgraded its long-term ratings for Boatmen's National Bank of St. Louis and Boatmen's First National Bank of Kansas City, both now subsidiaries of NationsBank, to AA minus from A plus.
"The short-term ratings remain at A1," IBCA said in a statement.
IBCA said that following the completion of the merger of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc and NationsBank, it has withdrawn its ratings for Boatmen's Bancshares Inc.
"Both companies have been reporting solid performance in recent periods," the agency said. "In addition, the acquisition makes good strategic sense."

The agency said the move would benefit from a franchise that spans the Southeast, Southwest and Midwestern U.S., with more than 13 million customers in 16 states, the ability to leverage NationsBank's products and services across new markets, and the addition of Boatmen's strong core deposit base.
IBCA said the use of purchase accounting will give rise to more than $6.0 billion of intangibles, but asset quality remains strong and capital is adequate.
Despite challenges associated with the integration of Boatmen's, IBCA said it believes the outlook for NationsBank is positive.
